To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) we have developed a full-text search engine that can efficiently support XQFT, and (b), we have developed a scoring framework that can efficiently support the scoring of XQuery and XQuery full-text queries.
we have built an open source data management system called Quark that can efficiently support full-text search over XML data, including the scoring and ranking of full-text queries.
we can efficiently integrate full-text search with XML data management, and that we can efficiently score and rank arbitrary structured and unstructured queries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of an XQuery full-text system that can efficiently evaluate complex queries over structured and unstructured XML data.
developing a framework for efficient and scalable evaluation of full-text search over XML data and for scoring and ranking such queries.
the development of efficient full-text search techniques over XML data and the integration of such techniques with traditional XML query languages.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Quark is an efficient XQuery 1 full text search engine.
we have shown how to integrate structured and un-structured search in an efficient manner, and how to score/rank both structured and fulltext predicates in XQFT.
we can efficiently and accurately integrate full-text search and XML query processing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is possible to integrate full-text search into a powerful XML query language, and that it is possible (and efficient) to rank arbitrary queries.
it is possible to efficiently and effectively integrate full-text and structured search in a single system.
we can now perform efficient keyword search over XML data, while still being able to score/rank both structured and unstructured predicates.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is feasible to efficiently integrate full-text search with a powerful query language such as XQuery.
it is possible to achieve a seamless integration of structured and unstructured data in XML query systems.
it is possible to efficiently integrate full-text search with XML data, and it is also possible to score/rank arbitrary XQuery/XQFT queries.
